description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rawathawattha, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520201 and other title settlements
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific details about land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and legal determinations regarding land titles. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land settlement matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters.
